title: Wiemer specs (v2)
description: A spec sheet on a full accent band: a very large centred heading, a pill of small mono tabs whose dark marker slides to the chosen tab, a measured drawing with thick dimension rulers on top and at the side, and below a ruled line, a note on the left and a two-column spec table on the right.
notes: the band is the theme's highlight colour with highlight-foreground ink: best with a bold highlight
each tab is a drawing view: give its width/height labels and aspect; the drawing itself is a slot (an outlined box when empty)
needs JavaScript for the tabs (hydrate: visible); static HTML shows the first view
